question.text: Unlike Cat I and II, a Category III AIF can be structured as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.2 (and Ch 5.9), Cat III AIF can be open-ended OR close-ended. Cat I and II are mandatorily close-ended. The Trap: Single-structure options are wrong. Cross-Exam Context: This flexibility is a Cat III differentiator. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Match structure to client needs: open-ended for liquidity, close-ended for long-horizon strategies.
